title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:132–163 implements conservative Euler flux, :478–610 assembles face and viscous terms; perfect-gas 2-D Vec4 state and report equations. Actual physical accuracy is limited by case results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:86–110 reads CGNS bases/zones, constructs connectivity, geometry and tagged faces; :690–773 partitions. Explicit two-dimensional restriction, no independent mesh geometry oracle.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics.cpp:478–610 computes boundary/interior fluxes and owned-cell residual; driver.cpp:86–112 globally reduces residual norms. Transient and converged physical correctness evaluated separately.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics.cpp:132–163 Rusanov, :165–245 Roe with NaN fallback; :576–580 selects flux at interior faces. Submitted M2 cases explicitly use first order.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: numerics.cpp:490–545 sets pressure-only wall flux and farfield ghost flux with viscous mirror gradients; no-slip surface routine reports zero wall velocity. Separate wall shear limitations remain.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: numerics.cpp:290–369 computes least-squares coefficients and gradients; :71 limited face reconstruction, default active. M2 first-order exception is explicitly reported; no demonstrated order-convergence study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics.cpp:372–430 implements Barth–Jespersen limiter and :71 density/pressure fallback; CFD_FIRST_ORDER and limiter disabling options exist, with M2 first order explicitly disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:1130–1173 integrates full viscous traction as the viscous force split, not tangential skin friction; surface skin friction at :713 is tangential. Stress/heat and no-slip paths exist.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp:470–528 updates reconstruction and executes implicit sweeps; numerics.cpp:806 implements LU-SGS. Nominal residual-based stop can mark strongly evolving forces converged (M2 laminar).

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:138–164 assembles BDF2/BDF1 full transient residual and :803–861 inner iterations; NaN ratio can evade miss count. Re200 fails by t=68.9; restart CLI is ignored.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: mesh.cpp:718–731 calls METIS and :771–773 clears global mesh; numerics.cpp:432–478 exchanges local ghost fields. No submitted independent np1/np8 result comparison.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
